svg.title: Past search schematic 01: the 1952 cave survey around Cave 3 (3Q)
svg.text: Past searches 01 — the 1952 cave survey around Cave 3 (3Q)
Plan to scale on the Palestine grid (km), grid north up. Points as de Vaux plotted them in 1953, digitized to about ±30 m (1σ).
27 legible points of 40 on de Vaux's map (pl. XX).
Circles show the ±30 m (1σ) position error of each point.
Notes give what DJD III (1962) pp. 6–9 records for each site.
3: cave c. 3 m deep, roof fallen;
finds at or just below the surface
c. 10 m wide; roof fallen except over a
rear chamber c. 3 × 2 m; jar-and-lid layer
30–40 cm thick in front; dug out completely
Cave 13 by their text: c. 0.17 km
north of this frame (2.8 km N
of Kh. Qumran; no easting given)
Caves A and B (1956), across 3Q's ravine c. 20 m apart: not plotted.
40 numbered sites, listed on pp. 6–12; 26 had
230 soundings found nothing. They are not located
Map positions were plotted by eye (p. 6).
The list does not say which sites were only
sounded. Deposits were not removed everywhere (p.
Depths are given only for cave 1 (ash to bedrock,
0.75 m), cave 3 (finds near the surface) and 3Q
Not searched: the marl terrace below the cliff,
which de Vaux calls "une erreur" (4Q and 5Q were
found there). One large cave was sounded but not
Cave 5 is "just above the roof of cave 8" in the
text (p. 7), but the 1962 map plots it elsewhere;
it is not legible on the 1953 map.
R. de Vaux, RB 60 (1953) 540–561, pl. XX (map, digitized here); DJD III, Textes (1962) pp. 4–16 (the
numbered list). Patrich & Arubas, IEJ 39 (1989) pp. 43–44 and Fig. 1.
Affine fit on 24 grid crossings (RMS 5.4 m). Each point ±30 m (1σ), about ±60 m at 95%: drafting,
base map and datum, fit and measurement. Grid north of the 1953 map.
Which 1952 sites lie near 3Q and what was recorded there. Only 3Q is said to have been dug out
completely; for the others the record gives contents, not how deep anyone dug.
No site is identified by distance alone. Patrich & Arubas's Cave 13 stays unidentified (their figure
and text differ by c. 0.4 km). The 230 empty soundings cannot be drawn.
